_readme: Nudges for everything drawn on a freeplay capsule, so it can be placed without
rebuilding the game. Edit, back out of freeplay and go back in - it is read fresh
each time the menu is built.
Positive x moves right, positive y moves down. Every number here is an offset from
where the code already puts things, so all zeroes is the built-in placement.
The *Scale entries multiply a sprite's size; 1 leaves it alone.
bpmDigitGap and difficultyDigitGap are the spacing between digits.
antialiasText smooths the small labels and the generated week name.
